Majesty,Ⓒs.ⒹrAjaSrIH, rAjapratApaH-tejas n., rAjamahiman m. -praBAvaH-gOravaM, pratApaH, rAjatvaM, tejaH, praBAvaH, ESvaryaM, mahiman m., vEBavaM, viBUti f., gOravaM, mahattvaM; ‘your m(ajesty)’ devaH, mahArAjaH, devapAdAH, svAmin m., SrImaddevapAdAH, praBuH, praBavizRuH; (in addressing) deva, mahArAja, &c.
Ⓝ[Majest]ic, [Majest]ical,Ⓒa.ⒹrAjayogya, rAjatulya, nfpocita, rAjatejomaya (yI f.), rAjaSrImat, rAjapratApavat, sAnuBAva, sAvazwaMBa, pratApavat, ESvara (rI f.), viBUtimat, praBAvavat, o-jasvin; unnata, atiprOQa, ujjvala, uttuMga; See Lofty also; ‘m(ajestic) splendour’ dIpti f.; ‘m(ajestic) dignity’ anuBAvaH, avazwaMBaH, oja-svitA.
Ⓝ[Majest]ically,Ⓒadv.ⒹrAjasadfSaM, sAvazwaMBaM, sAnuBAvaM, nfpocitaM, rAjapratApena-tejasA-mahimnA, sapratApaM, sapraBAvaM, ESvaryeRa, sagOravaM.
